files.content:
# Pixel Tip Calculator

A pixel-art themed tip calculator built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Works offline in any modern browser.

## Features

- Enter bill amount and number of people
- Select tip percentage (10%, 15%, 20%) with accessible toggle buttons
- Real-time calculation of tip and total per person
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pixel-art aesthetic using CSS only

## Usage

Open `index.html` in your browser. No server or build step required.

## File Structure

- `index.html` – Main page structure
- `style.css` – Pixel-art styling and responsive layout
- `script.js` – Calculation logic and event handling

## Accessibility

- All controls have visible labels
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate selection
- Results are announced via `aria-live`
- Focus outlines are clearly visible

## Browser Support

Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
